notes.title: November 2 Update
notes.content:
1) The speed and power levels of monsters in the early minutes have been reduced.
2) The monsters' push-back functionality has been fixed
3) Some minor issues have been fixed

notes.title: November 1 Update
notes.content: The boss that used to appear at the 20th second after starting the game has been updated to now spawn at the 10-minute mark. New updates will be coming soon.
